name: flag-checkered
description: A checkered flag marking a race finish.
useCase: Mark the end of a race or course.
misuse: Pair this symbol with a clear label when its meaning depends on context.

16.reason: Five alternating filled cells form a three-by-three pattern without internal grid strokes. Four white cells keep a minimum 1.5px opening at text size.

24.reason: Five alternating filled cells meet the outlined flag without internal grid strokes. Four white cells keep a minimum 2.75px opening.
